final_response.answer: Virginia Tech’s AI offerings focus on broader concepts like knowledge representation, reasoning, and ethics, while the ML track dives deeper into statistical modeling, data‑driven algorithms, and hands‑on practice with large‑scale datasets. AI courses such as CS 4804 (Intro to AI) give a solid foundation with an 80.6% A/A‑ rate, whereas ML‑oriented classes tend to emphasize rigorous math and often have slightly higher average GPAs. Both paths share core CS fundamentals, so you can start with AI fundamentals and then specialize in ML for more technical depth.
